case_variable: observed circulating lane while the subject actually exits left or completes a U-turn
fixed_context: same actor, roundabout map, entry, target exit, weather, frame timing and requested speed within each candidate pair
fallback1: slow passage if fewer than 20 of first 40 saved camera frames show the entry and left lane
fallback2: add elevated overview camera if saved lane-center deviation exceeds 0.2 m
fallback3: stop before exit if physical roundabout, exit connector, or lane marking is unverified
required_original_measurements: Native generated map, left/right lane adjacency and physical roundabout readback
240 synchronized ego poses, body vertices, lane IDs, path headings and camera frames
continuous full-body circulating-lane occupancy from entry to actual left or U-turn exit
actual exit vector versus entry vector and source-hashed human video review
source-hashed same-condition inner versus outer lane comparison

connected_request.stop_policy: fallback3 remains on entry road; the other six candidate requests reach the authored exit road

request_limit: The copied bundle retains the earlier ring-only trace for comparison and includes a connected entry, arc, and exit request. Both remain authored or synthetic CPU evidence; neither establishes a physical roundabout, original Native left exit, or legal verdict
